resources.string: Use your own account with a provider. Your API key is encrypted with this device\'s keystore, never written into projects, and only sent to the endpoint below. Project files are sent only when you attach them.
Use an https:// address (plain http only for a server on this device or your local network).
Saved key (leave empty to keep it)
Stored encrypted on this device only.
Ask about your project, or describe a change. Attach the files it concerns; changes come back as diffs you can review and apply one by one.
The reply hit the length limit and was cut off. Files that were not finished cannot be applied.
The model declined to answer this request.
Build It generates this file from the designer, blocks or project settings; regenerating it later will ask before overwriting your change.
This file changed after it was sent to the model. The diff is against the current file, so applying may undo your newer edit.
The reply was cut off inside this file, so it can\'t be applied.
This path is outside the project and was ignored.
Build It manages this file; it can\'t be changed here.
This path is not a text file.
The proposed file is too large.
Not applied: the file changed since this diff was made. Ask again to get a fresh change.
The provider rejected the API key. Check it in AI provider settings.
Rate limit reached. Wait a moment and try again.
The provider is overloaded. Try again shortly.
The endpoint or model was not found. Check the model name and URL.
